description: Solo-developer onboarding profile for basecoat-sheen. Mirrors basecoat's solo-dev profile: minimal ceremony, local telemetry and secrets, no team gates.

branch_protection.rationale: solo-dev branch_policy is 'minimal' - no required human review; CI is the gate. Raise to team-dev to enable reviews and protected branches.

org_ruleset_override.note: The IBuySpy-Shared org enforces branch rulesets on main that supersede this repo-level solo policy.
enforced: Changes must be made through a pull request (no direct push to main)
All GitHub Actions must be pinned to a full-length commit SHA
Waiting for Code Scanning results before merge

workflow_pack_solo.note: basecoat ships ~95 org-scale workflows across team/regulated packs. The solo pack keeps only asset validation, token lint, and optional docs build.

secrets.note: secrets_mode=local - no repo/org secrets required for the solo pack. Never commit secrets; see .gitignore.

scan_scope.note: vendor/basecoat is read-only and validated upstream; sheen CI never scans it.

upgrade_path.how: Set branch_policy=shared, enable branch_protection, add reviewer/PR-gate workflows, move telemetry/secrets to workflow scope.
